Specification: This module provides a TLAPS proof of the safety properties of a readers-writers specification. The main properties proved are that the system maintains type correctness (TypeOK) and a safety property (Safety) throughout all behaviors, as asserted by the temporal formulas Spec => []TypeOK and Spec => []Safety. The proof is inductive, relying on the fact that the head of the waiting sequence is always a 2-tuple with the first component being either "read" or "write", and that the set of writers never contains more than one element. The proof uses explicit assumptions about the finiteness of actors and leverages lemmas about sequences. The design is modular, with most system details inherited from the ReadersWriters module, and the proof is structured hierarchically using TLAPS constructs.
TheoremNames:
HeadInSeqRange ==
  ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), s # << >>
  PROVE  Head(s) \in T
  OBVIOUS

TailIsSeq ==
  ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), s # << >>
  PROVE  Tail(s) \in Seq(T)
  OBVIOUS
AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), s # << >> PROVE  Head(s) \in T
ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), s # << >> PROVE  Tail(s) \in Seq(T)
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryRead(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryWrite(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW actor \in readers \cup writers, StopActivity(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryRead(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryWrite(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW actor \in readers \cup writers, StopActivity(actor) PROVE  TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryRead(actor) PROVE  Safety'
ASSUME NEW actor \in Actors, TryWrite(actor) PROVE  Safety'
ASSUME NEW actor \in readers \cup writers, StopActivity(actor) PROVE  Safety'
